Geographies Served Programs Health and Well-being District Jaipur Alwar Bikaner Karauli State Rajasthan District Jaipur Alwar Bikaner Karauli States Rajasthan Through its health interventions, SGJSS has directly improved the quality of life for thousands of families. Under the Revised National Tuberculosis Control Program (2009–14), the organization screened over 70,000 individuals and supported more than 20,000 patients with medicines and follow-up care, contributing to a measurable reduction in TB incidence in Alwar and Karoli districts. As Rajasthan’s state coordinator for the Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (2014–2023), SGJSS impacted millions of women by ensuring access to financial incentives, antenatal care, and nutritional support. These initiatives have helped reduce maternal mortality rates, increase institutional deliveries, and improve overall maternal health outcomes. Women’s Empowerment and Livelihoods District Sikar Jaipur Udaipur Bikaner State Rajasthan District Sikar Jaipur Udaipur Bikaner States Rajasthan SGJSS’s work has enabled thousands of women to achieve economic independence. Its nutrition and food distribution training (2011–13) reached over 1,200 women supervisors and Anganwadi workers, benefiting more than 10,000 pregnant women and children. More recently, the sanitary napkin manufacturing program supported by NABARD has trained 90 women and raised menstrual health awareness among 20,000 others, paving the way for both sustainable livelihoods and improved hygiene practices. Women engaged in these initiatives report enhanced confidence, financial literacy, and decision-making power in their households and communities. Education and Digital Literacy District Jaipur Bikaner State Rajasthan District Jaipur Bikaner States Rajasthan By promoting education and digital skills, SGJSS has opened doors of opportunity for marginalized groups. Over 1,500 orphans gained access to education and healthcare through SGJSS initiatives, while rural literacy programs under NDLM (2014–16) and PMGDISHA (2017–19) empowered more than 35,000 villagers with computer and internet proficiency. This has not only enhanced employability but also improved access to e-governance, online banking, and healthcare services, bridging the rural-urban digital divide. Community Development and Crisis Response District Jaipur Bikaner State Rajasthan District Jaipur Bikaner States Rajasthan SGJSS has consistently stepped forward during crises. During the COVID-19 pandemic, the organization distributed over 100,000 masks, food rations to 20,000 people, and organized blood donation drives, ensuring community resilience during unprecedented hardship. Beyond emergencies, SGJSS’s farmer training programs have enabled struggling farmers to increase income through sustainable agriculture, while sanitation and clean-water initiatives have improved overall quality of life in rural communities. Environmental Stewardship District Jaipur Bikaner Ganganagar State Rajasthan District Jaipur Bikaner Ganganagar States Rajasthan In alignment with Guru Jambheshwar’s teachings, SGJSS has strengthened Rajasthan’s ecological fabric. From its annual pledge to plant at least 100 saplings to sustained partnerships with the Rajasthan State Pollution Control Board since 2011, SGJSS has mobilized communities for cleaner, greener living. Awareness campaigns, clean-up drives, and rainwater harvesting projects continue to reinforce the inseparable link between human progress and environmental protection. This brief highlights SGJSS’s multi-dimensional charitable work, measurable social impact, and continued focus on addressing health, livelihood, and empowerment issues in partnership with government and community stakeholders.Shree Guru Jambeshwar Sewa Sansthan (SGJSS), an FCRA, SSE, 12A & 80G, CSR1, and NGO Darpan registered non-profit, has conducted multiple impactful programs in collaboration with NABARD, focusing on women’s health, disease prevention, and community development. Overview SGJSS collaborates with national and local agencies to deliver health, hygiene, and empowerment programs. The organization is officially recognized for financial and CSR partnerships, ensuring transparency and the ability to receive foreign funding. Key interventions have targeted rural Bikaner, especially for women self-help groups (SHGs). Action Implemented NABARD-sponsored training camps for sanitary napkin manufacturing and marketing, benefitting many SHG women in Bikaner. Organized the distribution of over 1 lakh protective masks to vulnerable populations during health emergencies. Launched and coordinated programs focused on TB and HIV prevention, Motherhood worship, and skill development, including community outreach, seminars, and health screenings. Issue Rural women lacked employment opportunities and access to menstrual hygiene products. Public health challenges included the spread of TB and HIV and inadequate awareness. COVID-19 and similar emergencies led to a shortage of protective supplies and heightened risks in marginalized communities. Impact SHG women acquired marketable skills, enabling them to generate income and improve their family well-being. Distribution of masks and health awareness campaigns reduced infection risk and promoted healthier communities. Programs on TB and HIV prevention increased early detection, reduced stigma, and empowered affected families. Skill development and charitable services enhanced women’s social status and self-reliance in the Bikaner district. This brief captures SGJSS’s dedication to holistic social upliftment through targeted interventions, strategic partnerships, and measurable impact.
